sentences.text: The Key Facts Statement must include a computation sheet of the Annual Percentage Rate and the amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor.
The Annual Percentage Rate is defined as the annual cost of credit to the borrower and includes the interest rate and all other charges associated with the credit facility.
The KFS template shows the APR as the effective annualized interest rate.
The current KFS example discloses the APR as 8.70%.
